serviceDynamic: SOCKS5 has no fixed service endpoint
serviceRemoteLoopback: A remote loopback listener cannot be accessed directly from this computer
serviceStartFirst: Start the forward and wait until it is listening
serviceDesktopOnly: Open services in the desktop app
importHostBlocked: The source marked this host incompatible. Skip dependent rules or explicitly reuse a healthy existing host; importing it as a direct connection is blocked.
jumpOrderHint: Visited from top to bottom, up to 8 hops. Each hop verifies its own identity and fingerprint. An explicit route supplies the transport for later hops.
importFileHint: Choose or drop an OriaTunnel JSON configuration file. Review hosts and forwards before importing.
importDropFile: Drop a .json file here or click to upload · up to 2 MiB
importFileSize: The configuration file must be no larger than 2 MiB.
importSingleFile: Choose or drop one configuration file at a time.
importBackendUpdateRequired: Restart the updated app to load the new file import feature.
importHint: Preview dependencies and conflicts. Existing items are never overwritten. Select rules to import as stopped copies.
importHostConflict: A host with this ID or name exists. Create a new host or explicitly reuse one below. Duplicate names get a number suffix.
importMissingKeys: Private key paths were omitted. Configure a key or Agent before starting.
importRuleConflict: This ID or name already exists. Import creates a separate rule with a new ID. Duplicate names get a number suffix.
importListenerConflict: A configured listener uses this address and port. Review ports before starting.
importCommandMissing: The remote command was omitted. Skip this rule or explicitly import as forwarding only.
importForwardOnly: Import selected command rules as forwarding only (-N)
importStopped: No credentials, trust, runtime, startup preferences, or remote commands are imported. Imported rules stay stopped; automatic start is disabled.
hostUsedAsJump: Another host uses this jump route. Update that route before deleting.
logHostAssociationHint: Host association follows current forward configuration. Deleted forwards keep their original identifiers.
discoverHostsHint: Find hosts in your local SSH client configuration. Choose an existing host or enter one manually.
customEmojiHint: Enter one emoji or symbol; combined emoji are supported.
selectHostSearch: Search and select an SSH host…
allRulesHint: {{action}} · all {{count}} forwards in the current workspace
repeatCommandOnReconnect: Allow this command to run again on every reconnect
repeatCommandHint: Off by default. Without this permission a disconnected command session waits for manual start. Enable only when repeated execution is intended.
activityHint: Recent 1,000 lifecycle events. Local logs rotate across three 1 MiB files. No credentials, command text or forwarded content are recorded.
searchLogs: Search rule, event or run ID
targetHealthHint: Based on real TCP connection requests. A listening socket or successful SSH login does not prove application health.
socksHealthHint: Shows the latest SOCKS target request, not the health of every destination or its application.
reconnectPolicyHint: Bounded exponential backoff. Authentication, trust, bind and command failures require attention. Stopping cancels retries and clears the in-memory secret.
autoConnect: Connect this rule when OriaTunnel starts
autoConnectHint: Off by default. Requires trusted host keys for every hop and a key or Agent. Passwords and key passphrases are never stored; missing authentication requires manual start.
autostartHint: Start in the background after signing in.
failure-forward-denied: Forwarding denied or remote port unavailable
selectAllRules: Select all rules in the current workspace
batchAuthHint: Enter credentials per host, including jump hosts, or leave blank to reuse saved passwords. Each rule starts independently.
exportHint: Exports the selected rules and required host route. Excludes credentials, trusted keys, source file contents, commands, logs and runtime. Automatic connection is off in the exported package.
sourcesHint: Default user and system SSH configurations remain read-only. Additional files are resolved after the user configuration and before the system configuration.
sourcePickerUpdateRequired: Start the updated app to use the SSH configuration file picker.
autoSyncHint: Checks every 2 seconds and on focus. When disabled, startup loading and manual Refresh still work. No configuration commands or connections are executed by discovery.
metadataHint: Name and tags are saved in OriaTunnel. Connection fields remain a read-only reference to the source file.
identityPickerUpdateRequired: Start the updated app to use the private key file picker.
sourceForwardsHint: These are source information only. Discovery never creates or starts them.
duplicateHost: A similar host exists; you can still save a separate entry:
typeR: R · Expose a local service remotely
exampleL: Example: this computer :15432 → database on the SSH server :5432
exampleR: Example: SSH server :8080 → service on this computer :3000
exampleD: Example: local SOCKS5 :1080 → destinations accessed by the SSH server
socksHint: SOCKS5 CONNECT over TCP; loopback only, without authentication. No fixed destination.
remoteExposure: Non-loopback remote access also depends on GatewayPorts, AllowTcpForwarding, PermitListen and the server firewall. A listener does not prove public access.
localExposure: This listen address may allow other computers to access this forward.
noRemoteCommand: Do not run a remote command
noRemoteCommandHint: Forward ports without opening a command session on the SSH host. Turn this off to specify a remote command.
connectTimeoutHint: Timeout for connection and SSH handshake, in seconds (1–600). Authentication prompts wait for your input separately.
keepaliveIntervalHint: Interval between SSH keepalive messages, in seconds (0–3600). Set to 0 to disable keepalive probes.
keepaliveMaxHint: Maximum unanswered SSH keepalive probes (1–100). Reaching the limit disconnects the session; only applies when keepalive is enabled.
overrideConnectionHint: Off: inherit the selected host’s timeout and keepalive settings. On: use this forward’s own values.
maxAttemptsHint: Maximum consecutive reconnect attempts (0–100). Set to 0 to disable retries. A successful connection resets the count.
initialDelayHint: Delay before the first retry, in seconds (1–3600). Later retries use exponential backoff, capped by the maximum delay.
maxDelayHint: Upper bound for retry delays, in seconds (1–3600). Must be at least the initial delay.
identityAgentHint: Leave empty to use the system SSH Agent; enter none to disable Agent authentication. Custom paths use a named pipe on Windows or a Unix socket on Unix.
identitiesOnlyHint: Only try Agent identities matching a configured private key’s public key. Other Agent identities are skipped; explicit private key and password authentication remain available.
commandHint: This command runs on the SSH server when started. Do not put secrets here: the command is saved with the rule. Output is discarded; no interactive terminal is opened.
sessionOptionsHint: Source session options ({{options}}) do not affect forwarding or host tests. Remote commands are unavailable for this host until those options are supported.
inheritConnection: Use the host’s timeout and keepalive settings.
dnsL: Target names and localhost are resolved on the SSH server.
dnsR: Target names and localhost are resolved on this computer.
dnsD: Domain-mode clients use SSH-server DNS; IP-mode clients resolve DNS themselves.
reconnectHint: Saving interrupts the current connection and asks for authentication again.
closeToTrayHint: All forwards continue when the window hides to the tray. Restore from the tray icon; use Exit to stop all forwards and quit.
deleteHostHint: Deleting this host also removes these forwards:
configHostDeleteHint: This host is managed by an SSH configuration file. Remove it from the source configuration.
copyRule: Create a forward from this one
deleteRulesHint: Delete {{count}} selected forwards and stop their active connections. Undo restores the whole selection in a stopped state.
deleteHostCascadeHint: Deleting this host also deletes the following {{count}} forwards and stops their active connections. SSH source files remain unchanged.
deleteHostOnlyHint: Remove this host from the app. SSH source files remain unchanged.
deleteUndoHint: Undo deletion from the Forwards page to restore the host and forwards in a stopped state.
configUpdated: Host configuration changed; reconnect to apply.
movePortHint: Drag to move; Shift + arrow changes sides; double-click or Delete restores automatic placement
emptyBody: Add a forward to place a remote service on this canvas.
name: Name
authHelp: Enter a password or key passphrase, or leave blank to use a saved password, private key or system agent.
savedPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to use saved password; enter a new one to replace it
passwordStorageUnavailable: Password storage unavailable. Restart with the updated backend.
noHostsBody: Add a host from discovered SSH configuration or enter its details manually.
browserPreview: Browser preview: SSH discovery and connections are available in the desktop app.
trustHelp: Compare this SHA256 fingerprint with a trusted source before continuing.
sourceHint: Local configuration is read-only. Changes take effect on the next connection.
authFallbackHelp: Private key or SSH agent authentication did not complete. Enter the private key passphrase if the key is encrypted, or the server password for password authentication.

allRulesHint_one: {{action}} · all {{count}} forward in the current workspace

deleteRulesHint_one: Delete {{count}} selected forward and stop its active connection. Undo restores the whole selection in a stopped state.
